It is also included in the EPA's 'Substances Added to Food' inventory, indicating its approval for use as food additives or color additives under FDA regulations.
Q3: Limestone is not well-characterized, evidenced by an "Unspecified" molecular formula and a "Manual Registration; Registered Concept" substance class, which signifies an incompletely defined material.
